title: PBM Services Agreement Pricing Exhibit: Drug Cost Guarantees, Dispensing Fees and Market Checks
content:
Every PBM Services Agreement with Northbridge Rx carries one pricing arrangement, and the arrangement fixes how drug cost is billed to the plan sponsor, which discounts off average wholesale price are guaranteed, the dispensing fee per claim, the cost-plus markup and the interval between market checks of the pricing guarantees. This exhibit sets those terms for all six pricing arrangements.

## 1. Pricing model

The pricing model is one of three:

- **Spread** — fixed guaranteed rates are billed regardless of what the pharmacy was reimbursed.
- **Pass-through** — the sponsor is billed exactly what the pharmacy is paid, plus fees.
- **Cost-plus** — the sponsor is billed acquisition cost plus a markup and a flat dispensing fee.

| Pricing arrangement | Pricing model |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | spread |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | pass-through |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | cost-plus |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | pass-through |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | pass-through |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | pass-through |

## 2. Guaranteed discounts off average wholesale price

Each figure is a discount off average wholesale price. The brand and specialty figures are guaranteed discounts for that class of claim; the generic figures are guaranteed effective discounts measured across all generic claims in that channel. Under a cost-plus arrangement every guaranteed discount is 0%.

| Pricing arrangement | Brand retail | Generic retail (effective) | Brand home delivery | Generic home delivery (effective) | Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 18% | 80% | 23% | 85% | 17% |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 19.5% | 84% | 24.5% | 88% | 19% |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 20% | 85% | 25% | 89% | 20% |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 21% | 86% | 26% | 90% | 21% |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 21.5% | 86.5% | 26.5% | 90.5% | 21.5% |

## 3. Dispensing fees, markup and market checks

Dispensing fees are amounts in USD per claim billed to the sponsor. The markup is a share of acquisition cost and is 0% for every model other than cost-plus. A market check of the pricing guarantees runs every stated number of months; where the figure is 0, no market check runs.

| Pricing arrangement | Retail dispensing fee (USD per claim) | Home delivery dispensing fee (USD per claim) | Cost-plus markup | Market check interval (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 1.50 | 0.00 | 0% | 0 (none) |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 1.00 | 0.00 | 0% | 24 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 3.00 | 3.00 | 15% | 0 (none) |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 0.90 | 0.00 | 0% | 18 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 0.85 | 0.00 | 0% | 12 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 0.80 | 0.00 | 0% | 12 |

## Notes on reading the exhibit

- The arrangements that share the pass-through model still differ in every guaranteed discount, in the retail dispensing fee and in the market check interval; the model alone does not identify the terms.
- Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus is the only arrangement with a markup, the only one with a home delivery dispensing fee above zero, and the only one whose guaranteed discounts are all 0%.
- Northbridge Traditional Pricing and Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus carry no market check; the other four run one every 24, 18, 12 and 12 months respectively, in the order listed above.
